name: SKAZI REVERB
subtitle: Mega reverb machine
description: A rack-style reverb in the spirit of the classic studio machines: ten algorithms from hall and plate to shimmer, reverse, gated and blackhole. Pre-delay with echo feedback and tempo sync, FREEZE for endless pads, DUCK so the tail breathes around your kick, and a resonant tail filter.

name: BULLY
subtitle: Analog-character wavetable monster
description: Three wavetable oscillators, analog drift and a saturated ladder filter. Shape your sound with drag-and-drop modulation, chaos generators and a full FX rack.

name: SKAZI
subtitle: Psy / acid / VA synth
description: Supersaw unison, custom wavetables and a powerful sequencer. Perform with four macros, A/B morph and kick ducking, or roll a completely new sound.

name: BAMBA
subtitle: Riser & uplift maker
description: Create uplifters, snare rolls, impacts and sub drops across 1–24 bars. Layer your samples, automate the roll rate and build the tension.

name: TAHINI
subtitle: Space delay + reverb
description: Seven delay characters with filtered, driven and pitch-shifted repeats. Add shimmer, reverse, freeze and a spacious ducking reverb.

name: TBON 303
subtitle: Acid bass line synth
description: Classic acid movement with accent, slide and a powerful resonant filter. Build patterns in the sequencer and push fourteen drive flavours.

name: SALAT
subtitle: Glitch multi-FX + RISE
description: Rearrange your groove with synced chops, stutters and tape stops. Add a full FX chain and use RISE for long, tempo-locked pitch builds.

name: MIDI GOD
subtitle: MIDI pattern generator + audio to MIDI
description: Generate basslines, melodies, arps, chords and drums in your key across ten genres. ROLL BASS writes rolling psy and techno basslines around the kick. Drag MIDI into your DAW or turn audio into MIDI.

name: KICKASS
subtitle: Kick drum synth
description: Build punchy kicks with a two-stage pitch envelope, precise decay, three-band EQ and clean-to-driven tone. Layer your own samples for extra character.

name: SUBICH
subtitle: Bass + sub bass synth
description: Two oscillators and a dedicated sub, built for focused basslines. Shape the groove with dual filters, modulation, legato and glide.

name: SHAKSUKA
subtitle: Random chop & glitch FX
description: Turn audio into rhythmic chops, stutters and reverses. Add tape stops, pitch shifts, gates and filters with swing and evolving grooves.

name: PITAPUMP
subtitle: Sidechain LFO tool
description: Shape the pulse with ten pump curves or draw your own. Sync to the song, trigger from MIDI or follow your kick.

name: ZHUG
subtitle: Saturator + widener
description: Eight drive types, from warm tube colour to bitcrushed edges. Dial in multiband saturation, stereo width and a focused mono low end.

name: THE FILTERFISH
subtitle: Filter FX
description: Animate your sound with creative filters, LFOs and envelopes. Layer chorus, flanger, glitch, delay and reverb, or randomize the whole chain.

name: KUBE
subtitle: Psytrance wavetable synth
description: Two wavetable oscillators with 24 KUBE-only tables (growl, yoy, robot and more), or drag and drop your own Serum .wav wavetables. Two warp slots per oscillator, 16-voice unison with blend and width, sub, noise and wavefold, a filter, mod section and FX rack, in a lime-on-black skin.

name: QUAZI
subtitle: 4-band fuzz
description: A clean 4-band crossover feeds each band into its own soft, hard, fuzz or tube distortion, with its own drive and level. Drag the crossovers on the screen. The mix blends each band with its clean self, so half-wet never sounds hollow. Stereo width with MONO BASS and a 3-band EQ (low shelf, bell, high shelf) finish the sound.

name: SKACID
subtitle: Acid bassline synth · Special Shigaon Edition
description: A squelchy 303-style voice with accent and slide, driven by a 16-step sequencer that keeps evolving with chance, MUTATE, ratchets and swing. Play it as a sequencer, an arpeggiator or from MIDI, then push it through five distortions, OTT, delay and reverb.

name: SKILTER
subtitle: Morphing multimode filter
description: Morph smoothly from lowpass to bandpass, highpass and notch at 12 to 48 dB, with analog-style resonance that self-oscillates. Move it with an LFO, an envelope follower or a tempo-locked step sequencer, add drive before or after, and watch it on a live spectrum.

name: SKWIDE
subtitle: Phase-safe stereo imager
description: Push any sound up to 200% wide and it still sounds full in mono: every bit of width goes into the sides. An allpass spread engine opens up mono synths, the PHASE wheel and DRIFT move the image, DEPTH pulls it near or far, and MONO BASS keeps the low end tight.
